{{Quote|I'll draw him out. Run for the door. Get to the speeder!|The Pantoran guard, to Riyo Chuchi|<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" />}}
A '''Pantoran guard''' protected [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" /> In [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Pantoran guard]] was present when Senator Chuchi tracked down [[Slip (clone trooper)|Slip]], who she was trying to protect. However, they were also tracked down by the [[sniper]]<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" /> [[Clone X]],<ref name="Clone X DB">{{Databank|clone-x|Clone X}}</ref> who was hunting down Chuchi as well as Slip on orders from [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart|Rampart]]. The guard helped to cover Chuchi before laying down cover fire so they could attempt to escape. When the guard was shot in the torso, the two Pantorans entered a warehouse and took cover. Inside, the guard told Chuchi to try to get to their speeder while they distracted their assailant. However, the guard was [[Death|killed]], although Chuchi would be saved by [[Rex]], who had also arrived to meet Slip.<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" />
